en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 6. Hamzah ibn Muhammad al-`Alawi (rah) said, on the authority of `Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, on the authority of al-Rayyan ibn al-Salt that
Al-Rida (AS) said: “Allah has never sent a prophet until he confirmed with Allah that he would forbid alcohol, and that he believed in Bada'.”
